research_question: Can a simple ex-ante long-only stop-loss overlay improve after-cost downside/economic behavior across the frozen Generation-1 trend family without changing entries, trend parameters, or signal logic?

source_basis.yatl_adaptation: Use the same bounded source threshold set as a new long-only risk overlay; no new thresholds may be introduced after outcomes.

reference_strategies.selection_rule: Use all six survivors in immutable freeze order; no survivor is selected or excluded using HSSE-005 outcomes.

execution.entry_logic: Unmodified frozen underlying survivor entry logic.
execution.ordinary_exit_logic: Unmodified frozen underlying survivor exit logic.
execution.stop_measurement_basis: Raw market reference price of the filled long entry before fee/slippage accounting.
execution.stop_trigger: At a completed contiguous 1h close, trigger when close <= entry_reference_price * (1 - threshold_percent/100).
execution.stop_fill: Exit at the next contiguous 1h open; if the next fill candle is missing or outside the scored fold, record an unfilled stop signal and do not fabricate a fill.
execution.precedence: If both ordinary exit and stop exit become actionable on the same completed bar, execute one exit and classify the reason as STOP_AND_STRATEGY_EXIT.
execution.reentry: After a stop, remain flat until a new valid underlying entry signal occurs; no synthetic cooldown or immediate forced re-entry is added.
execution.gap_handling: Never interpolate or forward-fill accepted source gaps.

proposal_gate.unit_of_selection: threshold across all six frozen reference strategies

interpretation_rules: This is component evidence, not a complete Generation-2 strategy qualification.
A proposal does not unlock 2023-2024 known diagnostics, Fresh OOS, P10, P11, or Live execution automatically.
If no threshold passes, RIE-CAND-0030 is retained as negative standalone evidence and the preregistered queue continues.
